title: Add RBACv2 policy TTL, soft-deny gate, and audit-entropy mitigator with KMS introspection endpoint
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Introduce a set of coordinated changes to improve RBAC v2 maintenance, audit privacy, and KMS residency verification: (1) policy TTLs for RBACv2 role bindings and templates so expiring privileges require re-approval or rotation, (2) a soft-deny gate that routes requests from expired/ambiguous policy states into an enriched audit queue rather than hard-denying production traffic, (3) an audit-entropy mitigator that reduces high-cardinality trace identifiers in audit logs to limit cross-region linkability while preserving integrity hashes for forensic needs, and (4) a lightweight KMS introspection HTTP endpoint used by control-plane components to verify key region affinity during policy evaluation. This PR includes server-side implementations, a migration to add TTL metadata to existing policy objects, unit and integration tests, docs for operators and compliance teams, a console flag to surface expiring policies, and a rollout plan to enable soft-deny by default behind a feature flag. Motivation: customers need short-lived/rotating operator grants for compliance reviews and we need a low-risk migration path that avoids accidental denials during rollout while improving audit privacy for multi-region tenants.

review_comments: Miguel Santos: The TTL enforcement looks good but please add a targeted unit test for the eviction path in policy_evaluator when a policy's TTL expires during an active session.

Eve Nakamura: Concerning audit entropy mitigation — ensure that the mitigator preserves a cryptographic integrity token so audits can be proven; avoid irreversible truncation without a hash fallback.
Aisha Kapoor: Mitigator now emits both a low-cardinality pseudonym and an HMAC-integrity field; added docs and tests to validate HMAC verification in forensics mode.
Thomas Le: Small nit: console banner needs to show exact expiry time, not just 'soon' — adjusted to show iso8601 expiry in the UI component.
Miguel Santos: CI flaked on the e2e job once — re-ran and everything is green, approving after the final fixes.
Eve Nakamura: Approval (security review) — feature flag gating acceptable, ensure rollout plan communicated to SRE and Compliance.
release_notes: Added RBACv2 policy TTLs and a soft-deny audit routing mode to support short-lived operator grants; introduced an audit-entropy mitigator to reduce cross-region identifier linkability while keeping HMAC integrity tokens; added a KMS introspection endpoint for region affinity checks. Feature gated and rolled out behind feature flag 'rbac_policy_ttl' with migration. See docs/security/policy-ttl.md for operator instructions.
